bootstrap on 2013-07-19+ behavior: paired circular moving blocks versus V11, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822

global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the 36 prior performance-bearing formal return-seeking candidates plus both repair candidates, total DSR Sharpe vector 38; the invalid predecessor remains visible in G3 ledger accounting but has no performance value to insert

methodology.selection_metric: No winner selection or survivor reporting.
